paraphrase: Sanaka and the sages, with Prahlāda and others, ask Hanumān which is the supreme truth among the Vedas; Hanumān: Rāma is the supreme Brahman, the tāraka.

checks.note: E-text Rāmarahasya ch. 1 is located. After an opening list verse (rahasyaṃ rāmatapanaṃ …), v. 2 has Sanaka and the other yogins, with Prahlāda and the Viṣṇu devotees, ask Hanumān which is the supreme truth; Hanumān answers that Rāma is the supreme Brahman, the tāraka.

paraphrase: Rāma's mantras of various lengths are given with their limbs and yantras; their worship gives liberation.
